sidebar.homeDesc: Daily overview, live events and daily reviews.
sidebar.libraryDesc: Use the main panel to manage your books and collections.
sidebar.cultureDesc: Manage your movies, series, books and anime in the main panel.
sidebar.videoDesc: Your videos with interactive subtitles for studying.
sidebar.ankiDesc: Review your cards with spaced repetition.
sidebar.focusDesc: Manage your focus sessions and timers.
sidebar.calendarDesc: Manage your appointments and daily tasks.
sidebar.filesDesc: Manage your files, PDFs and documents.
sidebar.vaultDesc: Protect your credentials and passwords with maximum security.
sidebar.practiceDesc: Chat fluently with your AI partner and improve your language skills.
sidebar.trashDesc: Restore pages and lofi stations or permanently delete items.
sidebar.diagramsDesc: Create, connect and structure visual flowcharts in the main panel.

language.title: Language / Idioma
language.description: Choose your preferred display language for the application interface.

general.tabsWebDesc: Enables or disables the tab system on the web version of the application.
general.tabsDesktopDesc: Enables or disables the tab system on the desktop version of the application.
general.hidePinnedNamesDesc: Displays only the icon/emoji on pinned tabs to save horizontal space.
general.tabMaxWidthDesc: Defines the width threshold in pixels before abbreviating the title. Default: 400px.
general.restoreTabsDesc: Restores open tabs from your previous session.
general.enable3DFlipDesc: Enables a smooth 3D flip animation when revealing flashcard answers.
general.enableSfxDesc: Plays subtle sounds when flipping cards and rating answers.
general.videoFolderNotice: Note: Changing the folder will save future videos to the new location. Existing videos will continue working in their original locations.
general.focusModuleDesc: Opens the focus module in a separate dedicated window.

editor.spellcheckDesc: Highlights spelling and grammar mistakes in the note editor.

security.autoLockDesc: Automatically locks your sensitive vaults after a period of inactivity.
security.lockOnSuspendDesc: Automatically locks the vault whenever the computer goes to sleep.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.readerFocus: Reader Focus Mode (hide menus and sidebar)
shortcuts.readerThemes: Toggle Themes (Light, Sepia, Dark, Nord, etc)

storage.title: Drive Storage
storage.subtitle: Space consumed by encrypted application files
storage.unableToFetch: Unable to fetch storage. Verify if you are connected to Google Drive in the General tab.

video.title: Videos & Media
video.subtitle: Conversion and playback settings
video.autoDesc: Plays Web version for incompatible videos (MKV) and Original version for natively supported videos (MP4).
video.forceWebDesc: Always attempts to play the converted version (smaller and lighter), even if original is MP4.
video.forceOriginalDesc: Bypasses web versions and always attempts to play original file.
video.presetNotice: Fast presets (like ultrafast) disable B-Frames and fine motion estimation.
video.webQualityDesc: Pre-selected resolution when uploading new videos

backup.title: Data Backup
backup.subtitle: Create a local backup of 100% of your notebooks, notes, videos and flashcards.
backup.encryptedDesc: Recommended. Preserves original security. Files are unreadable outside the app.
backup.decryptedDesc: Warning. Your data can be opened by any database reader.
backup.includeMediaDesc: Downloads all PDFs, Videos and Images. Note: May take significant time depending on total files.

sync.title: Firebase Usage (Local Estimate)
sync.disclaimer: These values are estimates based on local network operations. Real Google Cloud Firebase quota may slightly differ.

auth.setupSubtitle: Define a master password to encrypt your vault and personal notes.
